1-config.js.role: CONFIG. Every tunable table and derived constant: world size and city ladder, player and building dimensions, Overpass/Nominatim/terrain endpoints and limits, OSM layer tables, graphics numbers, the NPC tables (species, sizes, fight moves, pounces, ages), human rig and atlas numbers, food boxes, streets and lamps, coast, cabins, cat, car and camera, Survivor (SURVIVOR_CONFIG with playerPlantFood), sky, rain, CITY_FILES and PICKS.

2-core.js.role: CORE. Math and spatial helpers every layer shares, plus the frame loop's state.

3-gfx-io.js.role: GFX and IO, two halves that do not import each other. GFX half owns: the saved Graphics choice, renderer, scene, camera, rig, view pose, lights (hemi, sun, moon) and the shadow setup with three's shadow-chunk edge fade (patched before any material compiles), the flat ground plane, the high-graphics MSAA pass, the colour and buffer helpers (rgb, cssColor, pushTri, pushQuad, bufGeom, tint, ribbon, areaGeom, box, cyl), the ground-cell splitters and cellCull, and perf (Graphics-low flag, LOD distances, instance uploads, setText). IO half owns: Nominatim geocoding, hedged Overpass requests, the hosted city files, Terrarium elevation tiles, and the OSM parsers (featuresFrom and its helpers).

8-render-player-game.js.role: RENDER, PLAYER and GAME. What draws the world and what the player drives. Render owns: the NPC frustum and npcOnScreen, the human rig (geometry, atlas, materials, PS2-era shaders), the billboards, AnimalRenderer, PlantRenderer, foodBoxView, BlobShadows, HealthBars with the brain view, StatLabelSystem (labels), VisionRaySystem, the sky (bodies, colours, fade, updateSky, the Observer presets in skyChoice), rain and graphics. Player owns: player, keys, play { active, locked }, stance, touch (touchKnob), fly and climb, swimming, playerStep, movementHeld, the car and chase camera, the cat and petting, pov and VR. Game owns: SURVIVOR_ACTIONS, SURVIVOR_FIELD_ACTIONS, cabinAt and game (Survivor rules, inventory, the run summary). Binds: bindInventory, bindKeys, bindMouseLook, bindTouch, bindCar register this file's listeners; 9-main calls them in the original listener order. Construction (meshes, canvases) runs at load.
